L=0.120; W=0.006; R=W/2; HLOOP=0.012; SPAN=0.022; T=0.001
starts=np.array([0.008,0.035,0.062,0.089]); n_path=18
gmsh.initialize(); gmsh.model.add('teslaValve2D'); occ=gmsh.model.occ
parts=[(2,occ.addRectangle(0,-W/2,0,L,W))]
def bezier(p0,p1,p2,p3,t):
    return (1-t)**3*p0+3*(1-t)**2*t*p1+3*(1-t)*t**2*p2+t**3*p3
for x0 in starts:
    p0=np.array([x0,0.0]); p3=np.array([x0+SPAN,0.0])
    p1=np.array([x0+0.002,HLOOP]); p2=np.array([x0+SPAN-0.007,HLOOP])
    pts=np.array([bezier(p0,p1,p2,p3,t) for t in np.linspace(0,1,n_path)])
    for p in pts: parts.append((2,occ.addDisk(float(p[0]),float(p[1]),0,R,R)))
    for a,b in zip(pts[:-1],pts[1:]):
        d=b-a; q=np.array([-d[1],d[0]])/np.linalg.norm(d)*R
        tags=[occ.addPoint(float(v[0]),float(v[1]),0) for v in (a+q,b+q,b-q,a-q)]
        curves=[occ.addLine(tags[i],tags[(i+1)%4]) for i in range(4)]
        parts.append((2,occ.addPlaneSurface([occ.addCurveLoop(curves)])))
fluid2d,_=occ.fuse([parts[0]],parts[1:],removeObject=True,removeTool=True); occ.synchronize()
